name: Big Lad
summary: You count as one size larger for grappling, shoving, carrying, lifting, dragging, and breaking objects. You gain proficiency in Athletics. Due to your enormous bulk and slow reactions in cramped spaces, your Dexterity score is reduced by 2, to a minimum of 6. This penalty is applied after the species ability score increases. You cannot benefit from armour, stealth gear, or weapons that require a normal human frame unless they are modified for Ogryn use.
